question: For each ACTIVE network, show the network name, its total number of security bindings, the average number of security bindings across all ACTIVE networks as a benchmark, and categorize the network as 'HIGH_BINDINGS' (at least 50% more than average), 'LOW_BINDINGS' (at least 50% less than average), or 'AVERAGE_BINDINGS'. Only include networks that have more than 1 security binding. Do not return any rounded answers.

WITH per_network AS (
  SELECT
    n.id AS network_id,
    n.name AS network_name,
    COUNT(b.network_id) AS binding_count
  FROM networks AS n
  JOIN networksecuritybindings AS b
    ON b.network_id = n.id
  WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE'
  GROUP BY n.id, n.name
  HAVING COUNT(b.network_id) > 1
),
avg_benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(binding_count) AS avg_binding_count
  FROM per_network
)
SELECT
  p.network_name,
  p.binding_count AS total_security_bindings,
  a.avg_binding_count AS average_security_bindings,
  CASE
    WHEN p.binding_count >= a.avg_binding_count * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_BINDINGS'
    WHEN p.binding_count <= a.avg_binding_count * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_BINDINGS'
    ELSE 'AVERAGE_BINDINGS'
  END AS binding_category
FROM per_network AS p
CROSS JOIN avg_benchmark AS a;
